_source: af_core lib/utils/rounding.ts (commit a2fe220). Applied by every reconcile route (invoice, supplier invoice, expense claim, travel allowance) to decide 'fully paid' on an underpayment. v3: the linking module's allocation tolerance rule; the base-currency (SEK) tolerance applies to settlements.
rule: isWithinTolerance = (total - paid) > 0 AND (total - paid) <= tolerance(currency). Overpayment is never within tolerance (and is rejected earlier: 'Total payments … would exceed amount …'). paid >= total → PAID without note.
note_format: Rounding adjustment: {symbol} {difference to 2 dp} ({name} rounding tolerance)
transaction_remaining: remainingAmount after a (batch) reconcile is normalised to 0 when |remaining| <= tolerance(transaction currency) (normalizeToZeroIfWithinTolerance); reconciledStatus = RECONCILED when fully allocated, else SUGGESTED (v1 oddity — v3 derives 'partially linked').
